how_to_add: Copy the stops and times from the official timetable, never from NTES/IRCTC scraping. Use the station codes in route.json. The first stop needs dep, the last arr, the others both, as HH:MM. Move the train from wanted to trains, fill source and checked, then run python3 scraper/journey_build.py: it refuses a timetable that doesn't fit the route.
